track.note: Corrected science-team traverse; some interpolated positions; not a PDS-archived product.

objects.name: Viking 1 lander
objects.notes: Published reference solution; verify map tie against actual HiRISE basemap before meter-scale placement.

objects.name: Viking 2 lander
objects.notes: Published reference solution; older planetographic values must not be mixed with planetocentric coordinates.

objects.name: Mars Pathfinder lander
objects.notes: Reference solution differs from later image-control/older published coordinates. Register to Atlas imagery before close placement.

objects.name: Sojourner
objects.notes: Separate rover from Pathfinder lander. Last-known local position must be transformed from rover/lander geometry; do not assign the lander coordinate as an exact rover position.

objects.name: Phoenix
objects.notes: Rounded position only; final hardware state differs from intact model.

objects.name: InSight
objects.notes: Published paper reports ~220m map-tie offset relative to radio-tracking solution. Do not mistake decimal precision for global accuracy.

objects.name: Tianwen-1 landing platform
objects.notes: A separate object from Zhurong. No independently verified free deployed-platform model found.

objects.name: Zhurong
objects.notes: Mission paper describes May18,2022 hibernation; HiRISE confirms stationary Sep2022-Feb2023. No current public position API verified. Image center25.125N109.927E is NOT rover coordinate; do not reuse landing point.

objects.name: Beagle 2
objects.notes: Paper image-control solution; other published coordinates differ. Partially deployed hardware, not a fully opened operational lander.

objects.name: Schiaparelli
objects.notes: Initial2016 official rounded location; later HiRISE refinement needed before close placement. Intact 3D model is a pre-impact reference.

objects.name: Mars 2 lander
objects.notes: Reached surface by impact; exact site not verified.

objects.name: Mars 3 lander
objects.notes: 1971 soft landing. HiRISE candidate identification remains tentative; reference region is not confirmed spacecraft coordinate.

objects.name: Mars 6 lander
objects.notes: Contact lost during descent/landing; no confirmed hardware coordinate verified.

objects.name: Mars Polar Lander
objects.notes: Lost on arrival1999; exact surface site unconfirmed.

objects.name: Deep Space2 Amundsen
objects.notes: Penetrator lost with MPL; location unconfirmed.

objects.name: Deep Space2 Scott
objects.notes: Separate penetrator; location unconfirmed.

objects.name: PrOP-M carried by Mars2
objects.notes: Carried by crashed lander; not a deployed rover with its own known position.

objects.name: PrOP-M carried by Mars3
objects.notes: Deployment not verified; do not plot as a separate mobile rover.

objects.name: Spirit landing platform
objects.notes: Platform/petal geometry not contained in the MER rover model. Image registration still required.

objects.name: Opportunity landing platform
objects.notes: Platform/petal geometry not contained in the MER rover model. Image registration still required.
